title: Cursor Claims AI Built a Browser. Here's the Problem
summary: Commentary arguing Cursor's agent-built browser was overhyped: it failed to compile at announcement, leaned on existing libraries, and leaves an unmaintainable pile of generated code.

assertions.quote: it's not actually functional or at least it wasn't at the time they made this statement

verdicts.note: The Cursor browser repository failed CI at announcement and reused existing libraries, though such projects do show substantial autonomous output.

assertions.quote: these billion-dollar companies that seem to have a mission of replacing developers seem to be really incentivized to tell everybody
What human in this world could go through millions of lines of code, find the fixes, and then implement them
